description.plain: Mixed product where one variant carries a numeric price alongside an unrecognized pricing mode. The shape is schema-valid for forward compatibility, but an unaware Platform MUST NOT treat that variant's price as range-eligible or safely comparable -- the safest old-consumer behavior is to suppress/recompute the range from variants it understands rather than assume this range is already safe to display.
Forward-looking mode this Platform may not understand, carrying a numeric price.
